about_the_game:
Paranormal Cleanup is a multiplayer horror game where up to 4 players take on the role of employees of a cleaning company tasked with cleaning up paranormal locations. You must work together to complete your mission, all while avoiding the relentless pursuit of the entities who try to hunt you down.

The task is pretty simple - all you have to do is dispose(eat) moldy pizzas, unclog dirty toilets, scrub ectoplasm and clean up some trash here and there. But beware, entities like ghosts, cult leaders or other paranormal phenomena roam these places, and they're not happy about your presence. You'll need to be smart and stealthy as you clean up, as every action you take will increase the entities anger. Can you complete your cleaning missions, or will they hunt you down?

The game is available in early access, meaning that it's not going to be completely finished yet and might contain bugs, but you'll still be able to play and enjoy the horror experience.

Right now we are on the "Road to 1.0", a development sprint until Launch in May 2025! Updates come in quick succession, containing new maps, enemies, objectives and customization options.

  • Up to 4 Player Online Co-op Multiplayer
    Survive together with your friends or struggle alone, if you have none

  • Proximity Voice Chat
    Nothing better than hearing your "friends" scream in the distance

  • Varied Objectives - Clean paranormal locations by completing different tasks, like unclogging toilets, scrubbing ectoplasm and disposing (eating) moldy pizza

  • 5 Unique Maps (3 more to come until 1.0 Launch in May 2025!)

  • Terrifying Enemies
    Every map features its own unique supernatural threat, ranging from ghosts to cult leaders and other paranormal entities.

  • Banish - If you feel up to it, complete unique and hard objectives to weaken or even banish the entity hunting you.

  • Scaling Difficulty
    Every action you take will influence the entities behavior

  • Progression System - Earn EXP and $$$, unlock and upgrade perks and new gear, customize your character.

  • Replayability
    Each Playthrough is different. All Item Locations and Entity Events are randomized.

  • Immersive 3D Audio
    Enjoy the spooky atmosphere while you hide in a closet

This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. Player discretion is advised.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 - 64bit
  • Processor: Intel i5 or new-gen i3 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: ATI HD7900 series or NVIDIA equivalent.
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: This is the lowest tested hardware that could run the game on medium settings.
